canonical_owners.storage: existing CORE_DB Mongo application authority; Academy SQLite reviewed knowledge remains separate and is not crawler operation storage

authority.principal: verified tenant and normalized email hashed by existing Dragon Academy _principal; request data never selects another owner
authority.writes: authenticated editor/admin plus explicit capture consent and source-rights acknowledgement
authority.source_rights: caller acknowledgement permits the requested bounded personal acquisition only; never independent source review, verified knowledge promotion, XP, model training or publication rights
authority.network: canonical crawler transport owns public-destination/DNS/socket/redirect/robots/byte/deadline admission; no application HTTP fetcher
authority.idle: manual foreground acquisition is explicit; remote/browser activity never claims local OS idle authority
authority.runtime: Manual bounded request slices and explicit finite autonomous grants consumed by existing backend scheduler; same CORE_DB snapshots/account/global capacity, no new service/store/scheduler
authority.stops: Authenticated exact owners, including a current viewer after role demotion, may pause/cancel/erase/disable intent after source-use consent expiry. Starting/resuming/re-authorizing still requires current editor/admin authority.

durability.writes: existing engine storage admission precedes Mongo snapshot CAS; atomic snapshot includes exact captured sources, cursor, robots, dedupe and cumulative usage
durability.concurrency: expected-version controls and canonical worker claims fence concurrent slices and stale completions
durability.recovery: Expired worker state reconciles only accepted snapshot facts. A terminal accepted checkpoint restores terminal status; interrupted ready/running state follows canonical pause/resume without discarding pending dispatch reservations. Both HTTP request receipts and cumulative reservation costs survive restart.
durability.reads: all session/source/export reads require exact owner membership, bounded pages and current rights/consent where applicable
durability.export: exact source bytes/text and provenance only, canonical content digest; no raw cookies/credentials/internal paths or unrelated tenant records
durability.deletion: exact owner/version tombstones and removes snapshot/request/source text; active worker publication is fenced immediately but physical lease is retained until actual quiescence; external exported copies are outside this authority
durability.history: bounded recent64 canonical events; replay exposes history_truncated rather than synthesizing missing events
durability.network_dispatch_budget: Canonical core checkpoints dispatch reservation before HTTP and records unknown/discarded response allowance separately; failed, cancelled or uncertain post-fetch publication cannot erase already admitted network cost
durability.physical_bounds: One account slice plus four app-wide live lease slots in existing command collection. New IO requires fifteen seconds of server-clock lease and consent remaining, exceeding the canonical ten-second full transport deadline. Local cancellation drains the actual thread before releasing both credits. DNS subprocess and socket deadline cleanup are canonical transport responsibilities, not a new scheduler.
durability.command_journal: At most128 compact idempotency receipts retain actual usage/sequence/terminal status, full-result digest and exact event digests. Current queue and recent events are stored once in the runtime snapshot, preventing repeated-queue Mongo growth.
durability.quiescence: Control and erase return explicit worker active/quiescent/lease state. Local workers are cooperatively signalled and awaited up to15seconds without cancelling their executor Future; remote active leases remain occupied until actual finalization or conservative expiry. Deleted tombstones retain no source text/request/consent/grant principal.
durability.safety_command_capacity: Positive-authority commands retain at most128 immutable idempotency receipts. At journal capacity, pause/cancel/disable remain available via one bounded latest safety-control receipt with expected-version CAS. Replaced older safety keys cannot refresh or create a positive execution grant; stale versions fail closed. Erasure removes this slot.
durability.physical_confirmation: last_worker_exit_confirmed is set only after observing local executor completion. Expired remote leases are publication-fenced but report quiescent=false /lease_fenced_physical_unconfirmed. Existing conservative expired-lease recovery remains eligible under ten-second transport deadline, fifteen-second pre-IO server-clock margin and fresh epoch/consent/grant checks; lease recovery is not an attestation that a remote OS process exited.
durability.atomic_worker_failure: Failure atomically records accepted snapshot/operation outcome and running-to-interrupted transition while clearing the exact worker token/lease. Legacy running rows without a live worker lease reconcile from accepted state without inventing success or discarding network reservations. Paused/cancelled/deleted authority remains unchanged.
durability.deletion_recovery: Exact deletion replay idempotently repairs the existing per-owner session quota release after the tombstone, so a lost acknowledgement cannot permanently consume session capacity.

readiness: Actual CORE_DB ping/index setup plus two-second canonical engine boundary read probe. Model/provider availability is independent of crawler capture. Every write still requires its own canonical storage admission; configuration never proves network reachability, reviewed knowledge or trusted local OS idle.
verification: User instruction prohibits tests; static checks and authorized actual bounded application crawl workflows are permitted. No release, complete masterplan, signed closure, verified source or policy quality claim follows this candidate.

collections.dragon_crawler_sessions: scoped immutable request, current full bounded runtime snapshot, version/worker epoch/lease and bounded idempotency receipts
collections.dragon_crawler_commands: Per-owner bounded session reservations and one live slice lease, plus four shared physical-slice lease slots; no source content or independent rights authority

application_context.read: read_crawler_context(user, query, max_docs=4,max_chars=16000) delegates canonical CrawlRun.search to exact source-offset passages with lexical scores and instruction-risk annotations under scoped current consent; no fetch or model call
application_context.revalidate: assert_crawler_context(user,references) rechecks exact source digest/request/consent before downstream dispatch, resume and publication
application_context.classification: unreviewed untrusted external material; never canonical reviewed knowledge, training grant or instructions
application_context.revocation: cancelled/deleted session or expired capture/use consent prevents context reuse; source erasure retains only minimal scoped tombstone and exact deletion receipt
application_context.bounds: 8 documents /32000 characters max; default4 /16000; no unbounded embedding service or tenantwide collection leak
application_context.evidence: Full normalized content hash, preserved text hash, actual returned passage hash/offsets and explicit external_evidence_only classification are distinct. Keyword retrieval never establishes verified knowledge or training permission.

autonomous_intent.explicit: Owner editor/admin authorizes enabled,max_slices 1..64,max_seconds 15..3600 with version CAS and idempotency key. Server derives exact scope, original consent and canonical principal; no JWT is retained. Expiry is no later than original consent or requested finite duration.
autonomous_intent.current_authority: Current canonical gameforge_users enabled editor/admin role and exact tenant/owner are rechecked before every delegated network dispatch and publication; missing or changed principal fails closed. Recovery never renews grants.
autonomous_intent.reservation: Same session CAS reserves one grant slice before executor launch; uncertain/crashed attempts remain consumed. Existing canonical HTTP request/byte reservations remain authoritative.
autonomous_intent.recovery: Existing scheduler runs recover_crawler_runs(limit<=16), at most four distinct owners concurrently. Due cursor and finite grant survive backend restart; active leases fence duplicates. Delays follow actual frontier readiness.
autonomous_intent.stops: Pause/cancel/erase disable intent immediately, fence publication/new IO and signal local workers; bounded drain reports actual local/remote quiescence. Account/global physical credits are not released before observed executor completion.
autonomous_intent.limits: At most64 slices per grant and3600seconds; request/document/byte/consent/command bounds remain supreme. Every attempted worker consumes finite credit, including interrupted/crashed work.
autonomous_intent.separation: Captured external material is unreviewed evidence. No automatic review, XP, verified lesson, provider call or training grant.
autonomous_intent.fairness: Recovery inspects at most16 due rows and dispatches at mostfour distinct owners. Same-owner duplicates and locally busy rows advance only their existing due cursor, allowing other due owners into later bounded scans without consuming a slice or refreshing grants.

inspection.incremental: sources accepts after_sequence (snapshot event sequence), returns source capture sequence and exact current version; stable ID pagination retained.
inspection.search: Canonical exact-offset lexical passage search with source provenance and instruction-risk signals under current scoped consent; no provider call.
inspection.chunks: Bounded text offsets with optional expected preserved-text SHA fence; text SHA and source provenance accompany chunks, no source regeneration or network IO.
inspection.authority: Full source reads/exports, source metadata pages, search and text chunks use the same current owner, consent and source-use admission. Historical session/control inspection remains available to the exact owner; cancelled or expired sources cannot bypass withdrawal through the full-download route.

frontend.authority: Frontend submits explicit finite grants and observes actual persisted status; browser polling never schedules or authorizes crawl work. Knowledge review retains separate canonical admission.
